# Bloomberg Law reports on Burford-funded claim against Google


April 16, 2025


-
-
-
-


Bloomberg Law reports on Burford's funding of a UK class action against Google. Lead counsel Damien Geradin is quoted: "This is the first claim of its kind in the UK that seeks redress for the harm caused specifically to businesses who have been forced to pay inflated prices."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-04-16/google-faces-uk-class-action-from-businesses-over-online-search-dominance)
